planets.name: WASP-15 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Nyamien with a 3.75-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: WASP-15 b was found in 2009 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Nyamien. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2009, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.7520997, pl_radj 1.41, pl_bmassj 0.54

quotes.title: WASP-15b
quotes.card: WASP-15b, formally named Asye, is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008 by the SuperWASP collaboration, which seeks to discover exoplanets that transit their host stars.
quotes.introduction: The planet orbits its host star at a distance of 0.05 AU every four days.
